text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If I stumble here... how am I supposed to
ever...
catch up...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up? Just saying that won't
change
anything...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: 俺も『お友だち』と同意見だ
私も『お友だち』と同意見

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: 負けたままでいいのか？

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: 負けたままでいいのか？

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
But right now... the distance between us
keeps
getting bigger... If I want to catch
up...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: 諦めないでトレーニングだ
諦めないでトレーニング

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If I give up now, the gap will only
continue to
grow. So I won't give up...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... let's get back to training right
away. I can't
afford to stand still.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I sense something brushing against my back...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel as if I've come into contact with its

emotions. They urge me to hurry after
Manhattan
Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if to reflect the tone of her words,
the air in
the room grows a little chilly...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I need to aim for the top... and keep
moving
forward...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I must be hearing things. I feel like it's
a sign
that I'm overexerting myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that we both have determination to
spare,
it's time to start planning for the
next race.
